name: control-plane
title: Control plane
description: A horizontally scaling control plane: a stateless front door with a fixed governance pipeline, the metadata of every resource, long-running operations, deployments that converge, and events; providers plug in per namespace.

layers.role: the stateless front door: one entry for every request, routed by namespace
whether the caller may do this on this scope
whether the result obeys the rules set on its scope, a partial update judged as merged
whether the scope is locked against change
how much budget the caller has left, reported on every answer

domains.role: the metadata of every resource: its id, kind, scope and provider, reconciled with the provider

slices.useCase: a client creates or replaces a resource in its scope, its metadata recorded
a client removes a resource, absent ones included
a client lists the resources of a scope

domains.role: long-running operations: their status and their result

slices.useCase: a client follows a long-running write to its status and result

domains.role: templates resolved into a graph of idempotent writes, run in parallel where independent, converging by re-applying

slices.useCase: a client deploys a template, its writes converging by re-applying
a client reads where a deployment stands

domains.role: the activity log and the events of every write, delete and action

slices.useCase: a client reads the activity log of a scope
a client creates or replaces a resource of the provider's type

contracts.via: an event per write, delete and action
the same API every client uses
